description_en: Queries the traffic data and the number of requests for multiple accelerated domain names at a time
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainMultiUsageData批量查询加速域名的流量和请求数类五分钟粒度的数据
name: DescribeDomainMultiUsageData

parameters.description_en:
The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple accelerated domain names with commas (,).

> *   You can specify a maximum of 30 domain names at a time.
>*   If this parameter is not set, data of all your accelerated domain names is queried.
parameters.description_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔。

> - 单次查询最多可添加30个域名。
> - 若参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名分组数据。

parameters.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
parameters.description_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO 8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC

parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time.
parameters.description_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO 8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

> 结束时间需大于起始时间。
